verification_method: Exact integer inclusion-exclusion over 2^11 target subsets, 2^5 prime-subsets; independent of the original Cartesian-product assignment enumeration.
what_this_proves: Only exact covering counts for x=12; no universal constant, asymptotic or source theorem.
elementary_global_necessary_bound: For N=x-1, any covering family of distinct primes p<x satisfies N <= sum_p ceil(N/p) <= N*sum_p(1/p)+number_of_primes_used <= N*sum_p(1/p)+pi(N); hence sum_p(1/p)>=1-pi(N)/N and a uniform covering budget strictly less than 1 is impossible for all sufficiently large x by the prime number theorem.
global_bound_scope: Necessary C>=1 only, not sufficiency and not a resolution of Problem 1200.
